name: remodel-model
title_zh: 下载的3D模型改孔改壁厚，五道门验完才给你
tagline_zh: 改尺寸怕孔变形？填孔掏空怕壁太薄？它用 manifold3D 实体布尔运算。
tagline_en: Resizing a downloaded STL without wrecking its holes? Every edit—drill, fill, thicken, hollow—passes watertight.
desc_en: Natural-language remodelling for downloaded 3D-print models (STL/3MF/OBJ): resize with hole-preservation, drill, fill, thicken, hollow, round edges, cut, extend, mirror, relocate. Backed by manifold3d CSG — every write op passes a five-gate validation pipeline (watertight / self-intersection / min-wall / overhang / dimension-chain). Activate when user says: 改模, 改尺寸, 孔做大点, 填孔, 掏空, 倒角, 'make it 5mm
why_zh: 不是网格修修补补，而是真 CSG 实体运算。五道验算门把「看着行」变成「测得过」，孔位、壁厚。
why_en: True CSG solid modeling, not mesh patching. Five validation gates turn 'looks fine' into 'measurably sound'—holes, walls.
limit_zh: 只吃 STL/3MF/OBJ 下载件；不改自己从零建的模型。验算门只认 manifold3d 内核，换内核不保证。
limit_en: Only STL/3MF/OBJ downloads; not for models you built from scratch. Validation assumes manifold3d kernel—swap it and gates may not hold. Output stops.
title_en: Resize downloaded 3D models with hole-safe edits, 5-gate.
